Refuter:8:1 is correct: the complement-of-open-ball argument allowed |x-a|_p = r. Step 2.1 now treats open and closed balls separately, replacing the false > r conclusion by the correct boundary-sensitive equalities.
Refuter:8:2 is correct: the base-p estimate needed |a_i|, not a_i. Step 1.2 now uses bounded digit absolute values and k-th-root limits, so the growth comparison is repaired.
Refuter:8:3 is correct: congruence mod p did not make the divided difference a unit. Step 4.1 now shows v stays within |h_0|_p of f'(a_0), forcing v != 0 and restoring uniqueness.

Refuter:8:4 is correct: M/D did not preserve the finite-place precision when p_i divided D. Steps 2.1-3.1 now use M = product p_i^(N_i+v_{p_i}(D)), so the archimedean adjustment keeps every p_i-adic congruence intact.

Refuter:9:1 is correct: the root set can collapse on the critical line. The example now uses the four symmetry factors explicitly, counted with multiplicity, so the polynomial remains degree four and symmetric for every nonreal rho.

Refuter:9:2 is correct: symmetry of the split integral did not by itself identify Lambda(1-s). Steps 2.1-3.1 now route through the meromorphic F(s)=1/(s(s-1))+H(s) and apply the identity theorem globally.
Refuter:9:3 is correct: the old proof did not justify locally uniform convergence. Step 3.1 now bounds the omitted integers by a uniform zeta tail on compact subsets of Re s > 1.
Refuter:9:4 is correct: Lambda is not bounded on the central strip because it has poles at 0 and 1. Step 2.1 now bounds xi only after the s(s-1) cancellation, which is the valid growth statement.
Refuter:9:5 is correct: sin(pi(1-2m)/2)=(-1)^m, not (-1)^(m-1). Step 3.1 now has the correct sign and therefore the correct Bernoulli-value formula.

Refuter:15:1 is correct: the old thinning sketch never defined the forbidden sets or showed enough survivors. Step 2.1 now chooses equal ambient subsets X_i, counts each forbidden family explicitly, and step 3.1 derives the final directional sparsity.
Refuter:15:2 is correct: q/ell >= epsilon^2 m was false. Step 4.1 now uses the valid bound w >= q/ell >= epsilon^3 m, which is sufficient for the later size target.
